content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in West Palm Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then gather evidence of your project leadership experience. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you verify eligibility before you enroll in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and receive comprehensive course materials. This formal education satisfies PMI's contact-hour requirement and prepares you for exam content.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your official PMI application with your education and experience documentation. Pay the PMI exam fee and await approval. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process and helps ensure your submission is complete and accurate.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides tailored to the PMP exam domains. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. On exam day, demonstrate your project-management knowledge and earn your PMP credential upon passing.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your certification active. Pursue continuing education, volunteer work, and professional activities that align with PMI's standards. Renew with PMI before your cycle ends to maintain your credential and competitive standing.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
